title: prunella vulgaris var. japonica
intro: Prunella vulgaris var. japonica, commonly known as Japanese selfheal, is a variant of the Prunella vulgaris plant, a species of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that may help to reduce stress, improve sleep, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Japanese selfheal include calming the nervous system, reducing fever, and soothing digestive issues, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids. The bioactive constituents of Japanese selfheal have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, contributing to its potential health benefits.
